Car Insurance Renewal Online 2026: Save 40%

Why Renew Online?

- No agent commission (saves 10-15%)

- Instant comparison of 10+ insurers

- Immediate policy issuance

- Digital policy on your phone

Step-by-Step Renewal Process

1. Gather documents (previous policy number, RC, Aadhaar)

2. Compare quotes from 5-6 insurers

3. Choose comprehensive coverage with key add-ons

4. Apply your No Claim Bonus

5. Pay and download policy instantly

Top 10 Tips to Save

1. Do not auto-renew -- always compare

2. Increase voluntary deductible to Rs. 2,500-5,000

3. Remove unnecessary add-ons

4. Maintain NCB -- pay small repairs out of pocket

5. Install anti-theft devices

6. Choose 3-year policy for lower per-year cost

7. Declare correct IDV

8. Renew on time to preserve NCB

9. Switch insurers if premium hiked >15%

10. Add NCB Protection if you have 35%+ NCB
